charts.title: HD 136352 c: orbits around HD 136352
charts.description: The orbits of HD 136352's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 136352 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Delrez et al. 2021 (2021NatAs...5..775D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DELREZ_ET_AL_2021): P 27.59221 d
